lore: Every season each island writes its save again, changed only here and there. Tallyman Oro keeps one copy of every chunk in the vault and a tally of which chunks make each save. Cut the saves at fixed fathoms and a single new byte throws every later cut off by one; cut where the tide leaves its mark in the bytes themselves and the cuts fall back into step right after the change.

lines.start: One copy of every chunk, and a tally for every save. Choose where to cut.
lines.tidemark: The tide left its mark here. Cut on the mark.
lines.shift: One new byte and every fixed cut slid along. Nothing matches now.
lines.win: Twelve seasons of saves, and the vault still has room.
lines.fail: The vault is full of near-copies. Cut on the tidemarks.
